misfeasance.definition: n. doing a proper act in a wrongful or injurious manner
misfeasance.translation:
n. 不当行为, 行为失检, 侵犯他人权利的行为
[经] 违法, 滥用职权

misfeature.translation: n. [计算机]性能不足, 令人头痛的性能（设计）, 让人失败（或白费力气）的特别机能

misfiled.translation: (misfile 的过去分词) vt. 归错文挡

misfiling.translation: (misfile 的现在分词) vt. 归错文挡

misfire.definition:
n. an explosion that fails to occur
v. fail to fire or detonate
misfire.translation:
vi. 不发火, 失败
n. 不发火, 失败

misfired.definition: v fail to fire or detonate
misfired.translation: v. （指枪、发动机等）不发火, 不启动( misfire的过去式和过去分词 ); （指计划等）失败

misfires.definition:
n an explosion that fails to occur
n a failure to hit (or meet or find etc)
v fail to fire or detonate
misfires.translation: v. （指枪、发动机等）不发火, 不启动( misfire的第三人称单数 ); （指计划等）失败

misfiring.definition: v fail to fire or detonate

misfit.definition: n. someone unable to adapt to their circumstances
misfit.translation:
n. 不适合, 不适合的东西, 不适应环境的人
vt. (衣着)对...不合身
vi. 不适合

misfit dislocation.translation: [化] 失配位错; 晶格失配位错

misfits.definition: n. someone unable to adapt to their circumstances
misfits.translation: n. 不适应生活环境的人, 不善和别人共事的人( misfit的复数形式 )

misfitting.definition:
-ing form of misfit
n. someone unable to adapt to their circumstances
misfitting.translation:
(misfit 的现在分词) n. 不适合, 不适合的东西, 不适应环境的人
vt. (衣着)对...不合身
vi. 不适合

misfold.translation: [网络] 错误折叠；结果变成非折叠或错误折叠；折叠成异常的构象

misform.definition: v. t. To make in an ill form.

misforming.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Misform

misfortune.definition:
n. unnecessary and unforeseen trouble resulting from an unfortunate event
n. an unfortunate state resulting from unfavorable outcomes
misfortune.translation:
n. 不幸, 灾祸, 坏运气
[法] 不幸事故, 不幸, 灾祸

misfortuned.translation: a. 遭受厄运的, 不幸的

misfortunes.definition:
n. unnecessary and unforeseen trouble resulting from an unfortunate event
n. an unfortunate state resulting from unfavorable outcomes
misfortunes.translation: n. 不幸( misfortune的复数形式 ); 厄运; 不幸的事; 灾难

misfuel.translation: v. (给机动车)加错油(尤指给该装非加铅汽油的车辆装加铅汽油)
